spans.s: खञ् tad. affix ईन, applied to महाकुल in the sense of a descendant; e. g. माहाकुलीनः cf.
), to युष्मद् and अस्मद् in the Śaiṣika senses (
), to words meaning corn in the sense of 'a field producing corn' (
), and to the words गोष्ठ, अश्व, शाला etc. in some specified senses (
-23). A vṛddhi vowel ( अा, ऐ or औ ) is substituted for the first vowel of the word to which this affix खञ् is applied, as ञ् is the mute letter applied in the affix खञ्.
